The Database Engineer III serves as a senior-level technical resource responsible for the design, implementation, administration, support, and optimization of enterprise database and data platform technologies. The position leads the engineering and support of Redis environments (standalone and clustered), OpenSearch platforms, and relational database technologies including PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and IBM DB2. The role also provides expertise in Oracle GoldenGate replication technologies, including real-time, batch, and bidirectional replication architectures. This position partners closely with application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver highly available and secure database solutions. The role participates in on-call support, disaster recovery exercises, automation initiatives, and technology modernization efforts while driving operational excellence across the database ecosystem. Responsibilities & Qualifications Duties & Responsibilities Technical Support & Engineering Provides advanced engineering and operational support for enterprise database and data platform technologies. Designs, builds, configures, installs, upgrades, patches, and maintains database infrastructure across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Leads troubleshooting and resolution of complex production incidents, performance issues, replication failures, and infrastructure outages. Provides technical leadership during incident response and root cause analysis efforts. Manages technical projects and initiatives related to database infrastructure modernization, platform migrations, cloud adoption, automation, and operational improvements. Redis Administration & Engineering Serves as the primary engineering resource for Redis environments. Design, install, configure, and support Redis standalone and clustered deployments. Build and maintain Redis environments on Linux-based operating systems. Implement Redis high availability solutions, clustering, replication, backup, and recovery processes. Monitor Redis health, performance, capacity, and availability. Design and support Redis cloud deployments including managed cloud services and hybrid architectures. Develop standards, procedures, and operational documentation for Redis administration. Perform Redis security hardening, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management. OpenSearch Administration & Support Provides engineering and operational support for enterprise OpenSearch environments. Install, configure, and maintain OpenSearch clusters. Monitor cluster performance, availability, indexing rates, and storage utilization. Troubleshoot search performance issues and platform incidents. Configure index lifecycle management, retention policies, backups, and disaster recovery processes. Partner with application teams to optimize search architecture and indexing strategies. Implement security controls, role-based access, and audit capabilities. Relational Database Administration Knowledge And Support For a Heterogenous Database Environment Including PostgreSQL Oracle Database Microsoft SQL Server IBM DB2 Oracle GoldenGate Administration & Replication Designs, implements, and supports Oracle GoldenGate replication solutions. Configure and administer GoldenGate environments across Oracle and supported heterogeneous database platforms. Support real-time and batch-oriented replication solutions. Design and maintain bidirectional replication architectures. Monitor replication health, latency, and performance. Troubleshoot replication failures and data synchronization issues. Support high availability and disaster recovery replication requirements. Implement change data capture (CDC) solutions and data integration strategies. Linux Systems Support Provides database platform administration within Linux environments. Install and maintain database platforms on Red Hat Enterprise Linux and related distributions. Perform operating system level troubleshooting related to database performance and availability. Support server provisioning, storage configuration, process monitoring, and patching activities. Collaborate with infrastructure teams to maintain secure and stable Linux environments. Database Security & Access Management Responsible for maintaining secure access to enterprise database environments. Manage database users, roles, privileges, and authentication mechanisms. Implement least-privilege access models and segregation of duties. Support security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation efforts. Monitor database access and security controls. Ensure adherence to enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements. Automation & Scripting Develops and maintains automation solutions to improve operational efficiency. Create and maintain scripts using Shell, Python, PowerShell, SQL, or other automation tools. Automate provisioning, monitoring, reporting, backup validation, and maintenance activities. Develop repeatable deployment procedures and Infrastructure-as-Code practices where applicable. Improve operational consistency through automation and self-service capabilities. Technical Expertise & Leadership Maintains expertise across emerging database, cloud, search, caching, and replication technologies. Serves as a subject matter expert for database technologies and platform architecture. Provides technical guidance to engineers, developers, and project teams. Contributes to platform standards, operational best practices, and technology roadmaps. Mentors junior engineers and assists with knowledge transfer initiatives. Required Technical Skills Advanced administration of Redis in standalone and clustered environments Redis deployment and support across on-premises and cloud platforms OpenSearch administration and performance optimization Redis engineering and operations Oracle GoldenGate replication solutions Oracle GoldenGate configuration and administration Real-time, batch, and bidirectional replication architectures Linux system administration fundamentals PostgreSQL/OrcaleMicrosoft SQL administration and support Database security and access management High availability architectures Scripting and automation using Shell, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies Cloud database technologies and services Qualifications Minimum Required Education and Experience Bachelor's Degree and 4+ years of experience in Database Engineering, Database Administration, Platform Engineering, or related field OR High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of experience in Database Engineering, Database Administration, Platform Engineering, or related field Additional Information Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates.
